errors.evidence: The label on the slice corresponding to 14% is “要素”, not “其他”.
The slice for “属性” (16%) is a medium-light gray. The slice for “行为” (50%) is a darker gray, and the slice for “要素” (14%) is black. Calling the “属性” slice 'dark gray' (深灰色) is inaccurate.
The label on the black slice is “要素”, not “其他”.

errors.evidence: The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from “行为” (50%) and proceeding counter-clockwise through “状态” (20%), “属性” (16%), and “要素” (14%).
